target_customer: Marketing teams at consumer brands running referral, loyalty, coupon and rewards campaigns
problem: Marketers depend on engineers to change promotion rules, which slows campaign launches and testing.
product_category: Promotion engine for coupons, loyalty and referrals

founders.name: Akhil Suhag
previous_startups: One of India's largest fantasy sports platforms (outcome not stated on YC page)

founders.name: Akshay Suhag
prior_employers: FanFight (built and scaled to about 8 million users)

technical_complexity.rationale: A configurable rule engine with real time evaluation, segmentation and personalization is standard but demanding backend engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Rules embedded in customer apps create some switching costs, but established vendors offer similar engines.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: CleverTap acquired rehook.ai in April 2025 to add promotions to its retention suite.

market_need_then: Brands in India ran referral and loyalty campaigns widely, and the founders came from fantasy sports apps heavy on promotions; no quantified demand source was found.

branding.domain_note: Used rehook.ai; the domain now redirects to CleverTap.

identity.voice_and_tone: Marketer focused, all in one promotion engine

rebrands.why: YC page calls Shopr.tv the company's former name; reason not stated and date unknown (Shopr.tv was still the name in October 2022).

brand_strength.rationale: Acquisition coverage was wide, but no brand specific evidence of community or recognition.

pivots.why: Reason not stated in sources; the YC page records Shopr.tv as the former name.

outcome_analysis: The team pivoted from live commerce as Shopr.tv, which raised a 1.7 million dollar seed in October 2022, to a promotion engine, using the founders' fantasy sports experience. CleverTap acquired rehook.ai on April 15, 2025 for undisclosed terms to extend its retention suite. The YC directory still shows Inactive, which reflects the acquisition rather than a shutdown.
notes: Status Inactive in the directory conflicts with the acquisition; exit set to acquisition. The seed round is reported for Shopr.tv; the link to rehook.ai rests on the YC page naming Shopr.tv as the former name and the founders matching. Search outlets disagree on headquarters (Mumbai or Bengaluru). CB Insights reportedly shows 2.9M total, unverified, so later rounds may exist. The YourStory article returned 403 so acquisition details come from search snippets.
